name: career-kit
description: Take one person from "I need a new résumé" to a complete, role-targeted application kit: country and employer research, a cited review of their current résumé and LinkedIn with real cropped evidence, one résumé per target role built from a single source of facts as HTML, PDF and Word, paste-ready LinkedIn copy, a bespoke personal website, an interview guide, and a project record a later session can pick up. Decides what it can decide with a model panel and asks the person the rest through one HTML form with suggested defaults and tap-to-fill examples, rather than leaving gaps in the document or filling them with plausible text. Ships a deterministic gate that fails any output carrying a figure absent from the confirmed-facts file. Also ships resume-craft, a second skill that knows what belongs in each résumé section, the structure and the voice, drafts or reviews a single section or a whole document, and lints structure and voice.
